label: Operations incident / Run 01
title: One worker stalls. Four systems recover the work.
description: A deliberately faulted recovery engine passed through Astra planning, Qwen implementation, Sonnet fallback, Opus review, Sol repair, and a Pi/GLM audit.
limitations: This is a recorded run, not a currently executing live session.
Stage durations are summed; they are not project wall time because the user paused between stages.
OpenRouter charges are metered spend. Claude dollar values are subscription CLI equivalent-cost telemetry and were not billed API spend.
Codex subscription stages exposed no comparable dollar amount. Adapter token totals are not compared.
The Pi audit was intentionally read-only and could not execute the external evaluator.

stages.title: Seed four interacting recovery defects
stages.summary: The isolated engine began with lost-update, stale-delivery, remote-regression, and interrupted-acknowledgement failures. The application workspace remained untouched.
evidence: Four of eight external tests failed before any model worked.
The contract and baseline were hash-locked in the run manifest.
The evaluator was copied outside the worker workspace before execution.
stages.lesson: A visible failing baseline makes the later acceptance result meaningful.

stages.title: Astra finds all four root causes
stages.summary: Astra traced expected-version conflicts, monotonic remote state, stale confirmation ordering, and recovery after a lost acknowledgement without changing the fixture.
evidence: Read-only scope passed with zero changed files.
The plan proposed adversarial cases before implementation.
stages.lesson: Use the frontier model where ambiguous causal reasoning has the highest value.

stages.title: Ten minutes of reasoning. No patch.
stages.summary: Qwen read the isolated fixture and produced a tool trace, but never edited either allowed file before the fixed timeout.
evidence: The failure was preserved and not rerun.
stages.lesson: A strong plan and a capable harness cannot guarantee that a model crosses the implementation boundary.

stages.title: The fallback repairs the incident
stages.summary: Sonnet restored version conflicts, monotonic delivery, stale-confirmation handling, and recovery after interruption, then authored nine discriminating regression tests.
stages.lesson: Fallback is part of orchestration quality. It must be attributed separately from the failed worker.

stages.title: Opus finds what green tests missed
stages.summary: The fresh read-only review accepted the core fix but found that rollback could mask the original error and a defensive invalid-confirmation path could remain pending forever.
evidence: Verdict: ACCEPT with two medium hardening findings.
The reviewer explicitly separated source reasoning from test evidence.
stages.lesson: Independent review earns its cost when it produces concrete counterexamples or hardening work.

stages.title: Sol closes the review loop
stages.summary: Sol preserved the accepted worker patch, fixed both review findings, and added focused tests that exercised the hardening behavior.
stages.lesson: A review finding becomes useful only when it is resolved and the acceptance gate still passes.

stages.title: A neutral harness audits the final invariants
stages.summary: GLM traced recovery, stale events, idempotency, ordering, and terminal cancellation from the final source, while retaining the limitation that its read-only workspace could not execute external tests.
evidence: No workspace changes and no delegation.
stages.lesson: The strongest evidence combines an external gate with an independent source-level audit that states what it could not verify.

stages.title: The system accepts the result
stages.summary: The final isolated patch passed eleven regression tests and all eight pre-existing external evaluator tests. The two validated hardening changes were then integrated into the Operations Lab.
evidence: Total metered OpenRouter spend: $0.1753783156 of the approved $10 ceiling.
stages.lesson: Agent completion is not acceptance. The independent gate, scope record, and preserved failure decide the result.
